name: api-smart-diff-benchmark
description: Benchmark of api-smart-diff against the published 1.0.6, the Netcracker api-diff fork and open-source API diff tools (OpenAPI, JSON Schema, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, Protocol Buffers)

scripts.setup: npm run fetch && npm run build && npm run fixtures
scripts.bench:openapi: node scripts/fork-tests.js --type=openapi && node scripts/quality.js --type=openapi && node scripts/corpus.js --type=openapi && node scripts/bench.js --type=openapi && node scripts/heap.js --type=openapi && node scripts/cli.js --type=openapi && node --expose-gc scripts/clone-baseline.js --type=openapi
scripts.bench:graphql: node scripts/fork-tests.js --type=graphql && node scripts/quality.js --type=graphql && node scripts/corpus.js --type=graphql && node scripts/bench.js --type=graphql && node scripts/heap.js --type=graphql && node --expose-gc scripts/clone-baseline.js --type=graphql
scripts.bench:asyncapi: node scripts/quality.js --type=asyncapi && node scripts/corpus.js --type=asyncapi && node scripts/bench.js --type=asyncapi && node scripts/heap.js --type=asyncapi && node scripts/cli.js --type=asyncapi
scripts.bench:grpc: node scripts/quality.js --type=grpc && node scripts/corpus.js --type=grpc && node scripts/bench.js --type=grpc && node scripts/heap.js --type=grpc && node scripts/cli.js --type=grpc && node --expose-gc scripts/clone-baseline.js --type=grpc
scripts.headline: node scripts/headline.js
scripts.all: npm run setup && npm run bench:openapi && npm run bench:graphql && npm run bench:asyncapi && npm run bench:grpc && npm run report
